name: Tetsujin Ganriser Tohoku Heroes
original_name: 鉄神ガンライザー東北ヒーローズ
overview: Ryudo Izumi transforms into Tetsujin Ganriser Zero using an artificial-type Gotetsu charm entrusted to him by his childhood friend Ouka Ishigami. Together with Ganriser MAX, transformed by Go Mitsuishi, he joins forces with heroes from across Tohoku to battle the Natta Oni and the Rakshasa.
